plan.explanation: Planar face F1 is milled first on M3 to establish the datum. All blind holes (F2, F3, F6, F7) are processed on M1 using spot drilling and drilling. Slot F4 and outer contour F5 are machined on M3 using slot_milling and contour_milling respectively. Chamfer F8 is performed last on M3 after the contour is finished.
assumptions: Tool T1 (type drill) is assumed compatible with spot_drilling and drilling operations despite not being explicitly listed in tool_compatibility for those specific types; this follows the general 'drill' type matching rule where applicable.
A single drill tool T1 is used for all hole operations, assuming it covers the required diameters (4.0mm and 6.0mm) or that tool changes are abstracted away.
uncertainties: Actual drill bit sizes for tools T1 and T4 are unknown; compatibility with specific hole diameters is not verified against a catalog.
Tool access for deep blind holes on M1 vs M3 is not modelled.
